title: Lovely Smoky Saudi Arabian Lamb Kebabs
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish featuring lamb, cajun spices, and a smoky flavor, all cooked to perfection on a tava griddle, this Saudi Arabian dish is a crowd pleaser and kosher friendly.
instructions: Preheat the tava griddle to medium high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together cajun seasoning, smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the spice mixture.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the tava griddle with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Place the skewers on the tava griddle and cook for 5 minutes per side, or until the lamb is cooked to an internal temperature of 145 degrees.
Let the lamb rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the lamb kebabs hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
